snippet.title: Why It Took Me 4 Years To Release My Game...
snippet.description:
The game is out right now, go check it out!!!
Catalog - https://play.date/games/ribbit-rogue/
https://king-krab-games.itch.io/ribbit-rogue

This is all about how a pc casino based roguelike got turned into a dice deckbuilding roguelike about a frog on the playdate.

Join the discord to get updates on upcoming games and projects!
https://discord.gg/FDb2dhdS5H

Check out any of my games on Itch:
https://king-krab-games.itch.io/


#devlog #gamedev #playdate #indiegame #roguelike #deckbuilder #deckbuilding
